fields.claim: Client 25793767: 12 serializer symbols; tag operator 0x14212b0e0 gates 441/282/503 and Map/Set 509; Array serializer 0x142123da0 takes a count and shared header at version >= 500 with mask 0x20 clear and an inner Struct flag; 32-bit size end minus start

Opaque header-reader fixtures pass for FloatProperty, TextProperty, NameProperty (GUID absent or present) and UInt32Property (4-B payload): GUID handling, arbitrary opaque payload and privacy; every truncation is rejected

The envelope inspector accepts strict BOM UTF-16LE and UTF-8 (4 MiB raw, 32 MiB out), validates all UTF-8 before field selection (N-005), needs named objects at root and blob (no positional arrays), and keeps only category, line and column in JSON diagnostics

The supplied heavy-world archive (2 JSON and 22 backups, 26,511,334 B, CRCs pass) is preserved; its 12 UTF-16LE envelopes pass Base64, zlib, length and SHA-1 (11 distinct), its 12 trackers match; current and backup decode to 18,513,234 and 18,492,675 B
fields.scope_and_limits: high; read-only intake; inner world unimported

inspect-save --recorders frames 2,744/2,741 recorders (5,488/5,482 field tags: a class string and a byte array each; 18,051,461/18,031,390 opaque B) as independent totals do; 16,384-recorder, 65,536-field limits; duplicate or missing fields fail whole

The native base-component reader frames tagged properties, None and a 4-B LE trailer flag 0 to exact EOF (64 KiB, 256 fields); flag 1 is an unsupported-GUID-trailer error, other values fail; it matches both selected 548-byte bodies

Native array readers (64 KiB, exact EOF): struct arrays are an i32 count >= 0, one shared StructProperty header even if empty, then None-terminated elements (4,096; 256 fields each; all 28 C028 arrays match); int arrays a signed count and 4-B elements (4,096)
